% Symbolic structure of $\ell_1$ at K=2 mixture OI.
% Generated by notebooks/closed_form_ell1_derivation.py step 9.
% The full closed form spans many KB after symbolic simplify(); the
% structural decomposition below is the practical interface — it
% takes the same form as Eq. 18 but with mixture partials.
\begin{align}
G^{\mathrm{mix}}_{\bullet}(a^\star, v^\star)
  &= \sum_{k=1}^{K} w_k \, G^{(k)}_{\bullet}(a^\star, v^\star),\\
\kappa^{\star,\mathrm{mix}}
  &= \frac{G^{\mathrm{mix}}_y A^2 - G^{\mathrm{mix}}_v L
       - \sqrt{(G^{\mathrm{mix}}_v L - G^{\mathrm{mix}}_y A^2)^2
       - 4 (G^{\mathrm{mix}}_y)^2 A (M A - L/2)}}
      {2 (G^{\mathrm{mix}}_y)^2 A},\\
\ell_1^{\mathrm{mix}}
  &= \frac{1}{2\omega^{\star,\mathrm{mix}}} \mathrm{Re}\Bigl[
       \langle p, C^{\mathrm{mix}}(q,q,\bar q)\rangle
       - 2\langle p, B^{\mathrm{mix}}(q, J^{-1} B^{\mathrm{mix}}(q, \bar q))\rangle\\
  &\quad + \langle p, B^{\mathrm{mix}}(\bar q,
         (2i\omega^{\star,\mathrm{mix}} I - J)^{-1} B^{\mathrm{mix}}(q, q))\rangle
       \Bigr],
\end{align}
where $B^{\mathrm{mix}}, C^{\mathrm{mix}}$ are assembled from the
mixture partials $G^{\mathrm{mix}}_{\bullet}$ by the same
multilinearity that gives the single-lognormal tensors. For K=2 the
fully-expanded rational form in $(w_1, \mu_1, \sigma_1, \mu_2, \sigma_2,
\kappa_v, \alpha, \beta, \gamma)$ is bounded in degree but spans many
KB; the structural decomposition above is the practical interface.
